rationale: Three stale comments across all three hook scripts document the old per-hook toggle variable names (CODEMIE_COMMIT_MSG_ENABLED, CODEMIE_PREPUSH_ENABLED, CODEMIE_PRECOMMIT_ENABLED) when the implementation was consolidated to the single CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED toggle; a developer following any of these comments will set the wrong variable and the hook will not skip. Confidence is low because no acceptance spec was available (sdlc-light no-spec run). Six minor findings were deferred (unquoted command expansion, missing SONAR_SKIP_TESTS assertion, two missing bypass-pattern tests, whitespace-only subject edge case, CI invocation without --commit-msg-filename). Two false positives dismissed (blind lens misread abbreviated diff — test isolation is correct).

standards_review.notes: All commits on this branch follow the required EPMCDME-<n>: subject prefix format.
No user input processed unsafely; env vars read with safe defaults; no secrets in code; no unsafe file writes; hook scripts run in developer-local context only.

New shell scripts use set -euo pipefail, carry Apache 2.0 license headers, follow one-responsibility-per-file convention, and include subprocess-level unit tests. SonarQube Cyclomatic Complexity gate (<=15) not at risk — all shell functions are flat linear flows.

findings.problem: Header comment documents 'Set CODEMIE_COMMIT_MSG_ENABLED=false to skip' but line 24 checks CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED — the documented variable is never read.
findings.impact: A developer who sets CODEMIE_COMMIT_MSG_ENABLED=false following the comment will find the hook is not skipped, causing unexpected commit rejections in emergency or CI workflows.
findings.recommendation: Change the comment line to 'Set CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED=false to skip.'

findings.problem: Header comment documents 'Set CODEMIE_PREPUSH_ENABLED=false to skip' but line 27 checks CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED — the documented variable is never read.
findings.impact: A developer who sets CODEMIE_PREPUSH_ENABLED=false before a WIP push will find the full pytest+sonar suite still runs and blocks the push.
findings.recommendation: Change the comment line to 'Set CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED=false to skip.'

findings.problem: Inline comment '# Set CODEMIE_PRECOMMIT_ENABLED=false (or 0/off) to skip this hook' sits directly above line 28 which reads CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED — the commented variable is never read.
findings.impact: A developer who sets CODEMIE_PRECOMMIT_ENABLED=false to bypass ruff/license checks will find the skip branch is never entered and the commit is blocked.
findings.recommendation: Change the comment to '# Set CODEMIE_GITHOOKS_ENABLED=false (or 0/off) to skip this hook'.
